# HyperTune Garage - Full Automotive Technical Knowledge Base & Service Specifications

> HyperTune Garage is Pakistan's premier specialized automotive workshop, computerized diagnostics studio, Paint Protection Film (PPF) application center, and European/Japanese luxury car care facility located in Islamabad (with Rawalpindi coverage via insured valet pickup while our Rawalpindi branch is under development).

## Business Profile & Metadata

- **Name:** HyperTune Garage
- **Industry:** Automotive Repair, Car Detailing, Paint Protection Film (PPF), German & Hybrid Vehicle Diagnostics, Body Modification
- **Hotline / Phone:** +92 333 0177717 (WhatsApp & Call)
- **Email:** info@hypertunegarage.pk
- **Operating Hours:** Saturday - Thursday: 10:00 AM - 10:00 PM (Friday Closed - applies to Islamabad Flagship Hub)
- **Locations:**
  - **Islamabad Flagship Hub (Open & Operating):** Shop 1-G, Ground Floor, Central Ave, Block E Police Foundation, Sector O-9, Islamabad, 44000, Pakistan — https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations/islamabad-workshop/
  - **Rawalpindi Hub (Coming Soon):** Currently serving Rawalpindi customers through our Islamabad Flagship Hub with insured valet pickup — https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations/rawalpindi-workshop/
- **Primary Website:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/
- **Google Rating:** 4.8 / 5.0 Stars

## Detailed Service Catalog (All 12 Core Services)

### 1. Paint Protection Film (PPF) Installation
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/paint-protection-film-ppf/
- **Description:** High-grade optical TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) film application offering heat-activated scratch self-healing, stain resistance, and UV rejection.
- **Technology:** Computer-aided design (CAD) plotter pre-cut film to ensure blade-free installation on vehicle paintwork.
- **Warranty:** Written warranty coverage against bubbling, cracking, and yellowing.
- **Packages:**
  - Front Package (Bumper, Hood, Fenders, Side Mirrors, Headlights)
  - Full Vehicle Wrap (Gloss or Stealth Satin Matte Finish)
  - Interior Screen & Piano Black Trim Protection

### 2. Car Detailing & 9H Ceramic Coating
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-detailing/
- **Description:** Multi-stage rotary and dual-action paint correction followed by liquid quartz / graphene 9H ceramic coating, interior leather conditioning, steam sanitization, and engine bay detailing.
- **Features:** Swirl & oxidation removal, high-angle hydrophobic water beading, UV protection, and deep cabin restoration.

### 3. Engine Repair & Mechanical Overhauls
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/engine-services/
- **Description:** Complete rebuilds and repairs for petrol, turbocharged, hybrid, and diesel engines to factory torque specs with OEM pistons, rings, bearings, timing kits, and gaskets.
- **Precision Equipment:** Cylinder honing, micrometer crank inspection, compression & leak-down testing, and cylinder head resurfacing.

### 4. Computerized Diagnostics & Pre-Purchase Inspection
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/inspection-diagnostics/
- **OEM Diagnostic Systems:**
  - BMW ISTA+ & INPA
  - Mercedes-Benz XENTRY & DAS
  - Audi / Porsche / VW VAG ODIS & PIWIS
  - Toyota / Lexus Techstream
- **Capabilities:** ECU coding, module programming, paint-thickness micrometer inspection, and digital pre-purchase vehicle health reports.

### 5. Periodic Maintenance & Lube Service
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/maintenance-servicing/
- **Description:** Factory-scheduled periodic servicing using genuine synthetic motor oils, OEM oil/air/cabin filters, spark plugs, brake fluid flushes, and multi-point mechanical inspections.

### 6. Brakes, Suspension & 3D Wheel Alignment
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/brake-suspension-steering/
- **Features:** High-definition 3D camera wheel alignment, brake pad & rotor servicing, AIRMATIC / hydraulic air suspension diagnostics, steering rack repair, and control-arm bushing overhauls.

### 7. Transmission & Automatic Gearbox Services
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/transmission-drivetrain/
- **Gearbox Types:** CVT, Dual-Clutch Transmission (DSG / S-Tronic / DCT / PDK / i-DCD), Traditional Torque Converter, and AWD/4x4 drivetrains.
- **Services:** Solenoid testing, valve body repair, mechatronics adaptation & programming, clutch pack replacement, and full fluid servicing.

### 8. Vehicle Wrap & Vinyl Color Change
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/vehicle-wrap/
- **Capabilities:** Cast vinyl color-change wraps in gloss, satin, matte, and metallic finishes, roof wraps, de-chrome / chrome-delete trims, and partial accent styling.

### 9. Denting, Painting & Accident Body Repair
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-repair-paint/
- **Capabilities:** Downdraft thermal-bake spray booth, computerized spectrophotometer OEM paint color matching, Paintless Dent Repair (PDR), panel beating, and structural frame realignment.

### 10. Body Modification & Custom Body Kits
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-modification/
- **Modifications:** OEM and aftermarket ABS, PP, and carbon fiber body kits, front splitters, rear diffusers, side skirts, spoilers, and custom facelift conversions.

### 11. Car AC Repair & Auto Electrical Specialist
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-ac-repair/
- **Vehicles Serviced:** All German, European, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and hybrid/EV market vehicles.
- **Services:** Automated R134a / R1234yf refrigerant recovery and recharge, compressor overhaul, cooling coil leak detection, climate-control flap repair, and computerized auto-electrical wiring diagnostics.

### 12. Cooling, Fuel Injection & Exhaust Systems
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/cooling-fuel-exhaust/
- **Services:** Radiator flushing and OAT coolant conversion, thermostat & water pump replacement, ultrasonic fuel injector testing & cleaning, catalytic converter care, and exhaust repair.
